title: Group Anagrams - Solution
approach: Sort each string and use it as a key in a hash map to collect groups.
intuition: Given an array of strings strs, group the anagrams together. You can return the answer in any order.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Sort each string and use it as a key in a hash map to collect groups.
time_complexity: O(n * k log k) where k is max string length
common_mistakes: Use sorted string representations as dictionary keys.
